title: Clear, bank and accelerate
prompt:
Six seconds, one continuous exterior shot. Start with the compact ovoid capsule already safely separated from the original massive graphite robot laboratory ship, as in the first frame. During the first 1.5 seconds extend the clearance gap smoothly along its present outward heading. Between roughly 1.5 and 3 seconds the pod performs one brisk, smooth bank with a small roll: its nose swings upward-right into open space, then the roll settles. From about 3 seconds accelerate decisively along that new upward-right arc, with restrained speed blur and a smooth camera follow that keeps the pod legible and lets the mother ship recede. The functional thin cyan-white ejection wake connects the initial departure direction to the release recess at first; as the heading changes, new wake follows the curved flight path. Brightest near the pod, the trail decays rapidly behind it into a long faint tail; it never becomes a tether, laser, solid line or spaghetti. Keep one pod, one unchanged mother ship, consistent hull proportions and coherent viewport/hatch/recessed drives. No abrupt kink, repeated spinning, teleportation, warp tunnel, sun, collision, debris, explosion, additional ships, cuts, dissolves, camera jiggle, audio or readable text.

ESCAPE SEQUENCE LOCK: Painted cinematic graphic-novel style matching the approved robot laboratory and escape doorway. Adult Harper has freckles, short curly auburn hair and hazel-green eyes; retain the same opaque silver halter top, modest framing and adult proportions. Headquarters is the original massive elongated dark graphite laboratory ark with tapering oval cyan culture galleries, amber longitudinal seams, asymmetric branching service spars and a restrained circular cyan aft drive. Escape pod is a DIFFERENT small enclosed one-person craft derived from its ivory-and-graphite boarding cabin: compact elongated ovoid hull, graphite structural ribs and seams, warm ivory cabin panels, one dark cushioned flight seat, cyan instruments, rounded boarding hatch, curved clear forward/side viewport and two small recessed cyan aft propulsion ports. No spherical bubble ship, biosphere domes or large external drive ring on the escape pod. Palette: graphite/ivory/cyan/amber, deep indigo-black cosmic background. Ship, cabin and pod design must remain coherent across views. No new characters, readable words, captions, watermark, panel divisions or collision-course solar framing.
reviewNotes: Prepared for first-frame/timing review. Preserve at least24sourceframes each side; final native window chosen after animation QA.
